profile.safety.title: Safety & Privacy
profile.safety.intro: Review recordings associated with your participation, raise a concern, or follow up on a request.
profile.safety.adminIntro: Review private requests submitted by campaign participants.
profile.safety.wrongCampaign: This request belongs to another campaign.
profile.safety.reviewers: People who can review this request
profile.safety.resolution: Outcome or reason (required to resolve or decline)
profile.safety.discovery: Attendance helps discover recordings; it does not prove your voice is present or limit what you may report. Only recordings you can already view appear here.
profile.safety.noRecordings: No associated recordings available. You can still submit a concern about an unlisted recording.
profile.safety.outcomes: You may ask to restrict access, remove a recording, or correct a transcript. Requests do not automatically change content.
profile.safety.shortEnough: A short description is enough. You do not need to explain why you feel unsafe.
profile.safety.confidentiality: This request is identified as yours. All listed reviewers can read it, including anyone involved in the concern. It is not anonymous; infrastructure operators may retain access. Independent escalation is not available here.
profile.safety.reviewerPermissionsHelp: The campaign owner can review requests. Granting a role access lets everyone in that role read all campaign Safety & Privacy requests, including existing requests. GM and Writer roles have no review access by default.
